title: The Sound of Dusk
text: When the evening folded itself into the window, even the quiet sounded like it had somewhere to go.
translation: A dusk note from a room with the window open.
hiddenLine: The night kept the rest of the sentence for itself.

title: Paper Moon
text: A small moon stayed between two pages, waiting for someone to finish the thought.
romanizedText: Ek adhoora khayaal bhi kabhi kabhi poori raat roshan kar deta hai.
translation: A small moon waits between two pages for the thought to return.

title: Soft Edges
text: Some goodbyes do not leave; they simply learn how to sit quietly in the room.
romanizedText: Kuch alvida kamre se nahin jaate, bas khamosh ho jaate hain.
translation: Some goodbyes learn to sit quietly in the room instead of leaving it.
hiddenLine: And sometimes, quiet is a kind of return.

title: The Last Light
text: Before the light left, it wrote your name once across the floor and called it enough.
romanizedText: Roshni jaane se pehle, zameen par ek naam likh gayi.
translation: Before leaving, the light writes one name across the floor and calls it enough.
hiddenLine: Morning knows how to read what the dark forgets.
